chunks: And from Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him) who said:

Allah, the Mighty and Majestic, revealed to Musa ibn 'Imran: Among My servants is one who draws near to Me with a good deed, so I decree Paradise for him. He said: O Lord, what is this good deed? He replied: Bringing joy to a believer.
ai.seo_question: What is the specific good deed that Allah decrees Paradise for in this hadith?
ai.summary: This Hadith Qudsi, recorded in *Kitab al-Mumin*, underscores the Shia emphasis on *taqarrub* (drawing near to God) through social kindness, specifically by alleviating the distress of a fellow believer. The narrative links the spiritual status of Musa (a.s.) with the practical ethic of *ifrāj al-kurba* (relieving hardship), framing the joy of a believer as a direct conduit to Paradise. This reflects the broader theological principle that service to the community is an act of worship equal in weight to individual piety.

en.muhajir-b-ali: 129. It has been reported that Abu 'Abd Allah (a.s) said:

Allah revealed to Musa ibn 'Imran: Amongst My servants, I decree Paradise for one who draws near to Me by a certain good deed. 'O Lord,' Musa (a.s) asked, 'what is this good deed?' 'This is bringing joy to a believer,' He replied.
